decisions: Leaderboard sorts entries oldest-first by age using Summit.db.find with sort:age dir:desc
Poll uses Summit.db.tally for server-side vote counting and percentage bars instead of client-side counting
Used Summit.db tables (leaderboard, votes) for persistence across reloads
Changed age column from int to real (float) to support decimal ages like 25.5
Set age input step to 0.1 and use parseFloat instead of parseInt to match the float storage
